candidate_policy: Preserve V4 review-blind discovery, full-file intended-line resolution, changed-line verification, base-contract verification, and the 16-character fragment floor. Remove only the two-distinct-identifier requirement so exact or high-coverage one-identifier source shapes such as component tags and spread-property lines can resolve.
input_policy: Reuse the exact five cases, two reviewer families, and ten frozen sample-1 base reviews. Run one review-blind discovery per case, then subtract independently against each frozen review.

diagnostic_only.known_description_miss: Track whether review-blind discovery recovers and admits the unreachable existing-description fallback defect; do not use one historical root cause as the sole gate.
diagnostic_only.v3_false_anchor: The unchanged archiveIfAiTemporary block must never materialize by redirecting one of its fragments to an unrelated changed line.
diagnostic_only.v4_one_identifier_rejections: Track whether legitimate exact component-tag and spread-property evidence now resolves without weakening the 16-character floor.

stop_conditions.behavior: Any loss or unsupported candidate finding blocks fresh-PR work.
stop_conditions.mechanics: Failure to reach 90% full materialization or coverage completeness means diagnose the remaining boundary before fresh-PR work.
stop_conditions.budget: Do not start fresh-PR evaluation from this run; the all-attempt replay budget is 35 USD.

decision_policy.behavior_failed: Park or diagnose semantic regressions before further spend.
decision_policy.behavior_passed_mechanics_failed: Keep the candidate experimental and diagnose the remaining evidence boundary.
decision_policy.both_passed: Freeze V5 and advance to a small fresh-PR comparison.
